tools.name: assembly.joint.delete
tools.label: Review Joint deletion
tools.description: Delete only the Joint. Child becomes a free ungrounded root at current world pose; downstream Joints retained. Select child. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.reparent
tools.label: Review Joint reparent
tools.description: Select child and new parent. preserveWorld true recaptures rest at current angle; false reuses local bind and moves subtree. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.edit
tools.label: Review Joint frame/limits
tools.description: Select child. editJson has origin/axis/min/max; null limits clear. No angle or type changes. preserveWorld explicit. Current angle outside new limits is rejected, never clamped.

tools.name: assembly.motion.inspect
tools.label: Inspect discrete Joint motion
tools.description: Read-only bounded BRep interference sweep. optionsJson: jointId,start,end,positive step,partIds 2..8,exceptions explicit ID pairs,tolerance 1e-7..0.01mm. start=end checks one pose (no duplicate interference API). Max13 samples. Reports raw and exception-filtered results; unknown is never clear. Native document unchanged.

tools.name: assembly.inspect
tools.label: Inspect assembly
tools.description: Read grounded objects, Joint graph, bind frames and paginated design-intent annotations. Annotations never change geometry. Motion rows expose structurally proven relativeMotion.

tools.name: assembly.joint.validate
tools.label: Validate assembly joints
tools.description: Validate stored Joint references/limits/cycles. No changes.

tools.name: assembly.joint.create
tools.label: Review Joint creation
tools.description: jointJson: id,type fixed/revolute,parentId,childId,origin parent-local mm,unit axis,angle degrees,min/max optional. Zero angle is current bind pose. Select both parts. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.update
tools.label: Review absolute Joint angle
tools.description: Select child; absolute degrees from bind pose. Review only.

tools.name: assembly.ground
tools.label: Review grounded part
tools.description: Select independent root. Grounded transforms cannot be moved.

tools.name: reconstruction.analyze
tools.label: Analyze planar Mesh regions
tools.description: Analyze components, boundaries, plane/hole candidates and adjacency. Optional absoluteTolerance mm (default 1e-5), relativeTolerance (1e-8), angleDegrees (1). Not solid certification.

tools.name: reconstruction.preview
tools.label: Evaluate planar BRep quality
tools.description: Read-only bounded OpenCascade reconstruction and bidirectional sampled error report. Open/multiple components refused. No direct publication.

tools.name: reconstruction.create
tools.label: Review planar BRep reconstruction
tools.description: Preserve selected Mesh and propose an independent merged-planar BRep after kernel validity/error validation. Native Preview/Apply only; no raw BRep injection.

tools.name: reconstruction.result
tools.label: Inspect reconstructed BRep
tools.description: Read reconstruction quality/face correspondence and source snapshot match. No automatic regeneration.

tools.name: hybrid.inspect
tools.label: Inspect Hybrid geometry
tools.description: Read source references, conversion receipt and support policy.

tools.name: hybrid.reference.validate
tools.label: Resolve Mesh surface reference
tools.description: Resolve exact triangle material point. Reports invalid/unresolved without nearest-face substitution.

tools.name: hybrid.reference.create
tools.label: Review Mesh surface reference
tools.description: Capture or explicitly reselect a named reference using object-local ray JSON {origin:[x,y,z],direction:[x,y,z]}. Procedural outputs require Bake. Native Review/Apply.

tools.name: hybrid.datum.create
tools.label: Review datum and precise prism
tools.description: Enable Mesh datum and create an exact rectangular OpenCascade extrusion with dimensions in mm. Source-preserving live dependency; native Review/Apply.

tools.name: hybrid.brep.toMesh
tools.label: Review planar BRep conversion
tools.description: Independent editable mesh from a BRep box or Hybrid rectangular prism. Preserves source; validates welding, closed manifold and intersections. Curved/general solids unsupported.

tools.name: sculpt.inspect
tools.label: Inspect sculpt target
tools.description: Read editable mesh brush capabilities, object-local coordinate rules, limits and detached bake status.

tools.name: sculpt.stroke
tools.label: Review sculpt stroke
tools.description: Validated frozen-source stroke JSON: brush grab/draw/smooth/inflate/crease/flatten, radius mm, strength [-1,1] nonzero, falloff linear/smooth/sharp, spacing [.02,1], symmetry boolean, samples 1..128 {origin:[x,y,z],direction:[x,y,z],delta?:[x,y,z]}. Rays hit actual source surface; grab uses first ray and last delta (max twice radius). Native Preview/Apply; never accepts raw vertices.

tools.name: sculpt.preview
tools.label: Evaluate sculpt preview
tools.description: Evaluate the same bounded stroke engine without modifying document. Returns a 120-second source-bound previewId. Same strokeJson contract as sculpt.stroke.

tools.name: sculpt.apply
tools.label: Review validated sculpt preview
tools.description: Prepare native Review from a valid sculpt.preview receipt. Reject stale/expired source. Existing native Apply policy remains: user confirms in editor; this tool cannot publish directly.

tools.name: mesh.bake
tools.label: Bake evaluated mesh for sculpt
tools.description: Create independent editable Polygon mesh from Mesh modifiers or Geometry Nodes. Retain original source, record snapshot fingerprint. No automatic rebasing after source edits.

tools.name: mesh.remesh
tools.label: Review surface or voxel remesh
tools.description: New object, original preserved. optionsJson is {method:surface,iterations:1..3,relaxation:0..0.5} or {method:voxel,resolution:4..24}. Surface uses uniform triangle refinement/projected relaxation; voxel uses closed manifold occupancy boundary (stair steps). Reject invalid/intersecting outputs. Explicit old-reference loss and sampled distance report.

tools.name: mesh.remesh.inspect
tools.label: Inspect remesh losses and deviation
tools.description: Read stored conversion report, source fingerprint, sampled distances and explicit lost topology counts. Not a certified geometric error bound.

tools.name: nodes.catalog
tools.label: Read node type and parameter catalog
tools.description: All supported Geometry Nodes types, typed sockets and exact default parameter objects. Unknown fields/types are rejected. Curve primitive supports circle {kind,radius,segments} or polyline {kind,points,closed}.

tools.name: nodes.create
tools.label: Create procedural geometry graph
tools.description: Create a working typed Geometry Nodes graph. Presets: mesh subdivision, open curve profile sweep, realized instances, or live selected mesh input. Reviewed validated Apply; file v57. No BRep conversion.

tools.name: nodes.inspect
tools.label: Read Geometry Nodes graph
tools.description: Read paginated node IDs, exact parameter values, typed links, live external inputs, active output and draft diagnostics. Read grants no edit permission.

tools.name: nodes.add
tools.label: Add typed geometry node
tools.description: Add a unique node with exact JSON parameter object. Disconnected nodes remain explicit inactive drafts, not successful evaluated outputs. Types and parameters are strictly validated.

tools.name: nodes.remove
tools.label: Remove a geometry node
tools.description: Delete an existing node and incident links. Group Output cannot be deleted. Required active inputs cannot be left disconnected; use nodes.edit for atomic rewiring.

tools.name: nodes.connect
tools.label: Connect typed geometry nodes
tools.description: Connect source single output to named destination input. Reject type mismatches/cycles. replace=true atomically replaces existing socket connection.

tools.name: nodes.disconnect
tools.label: Disconnect geometry node input
tools.description: Remove exact existing input link. Reject if active output becomes incomplete; use nodes.edit to rewire atomically.

tools.name: nodes.parameters
tools.label: Change geometry node parameters
tools.description: Replace one node's complete parameter object as JSON, using exact schema. Evaluation and downstream invalidation precede reviewed Apply.

tools.name: nodes.edit
tools.label: Atomic graph actions
tools.description: JSON array (1–128) of typed actions: add {node:{id,type,params}}, remove {nodeId}, parameters {nodeId,params}, connect {link:{from,to,input}}, disconnect {nodeId,input}; every action has kind. Only this graph can be changed. Final graph must be acyclic, typed, complete on active output and evaluable within budget.

tools.name: nodes.validate
tools.label: Validate and evaluate node graph
tools.description: Return structural diagnostics and actual bounded evaluation success/failure; never mutate source or pretend unsupported nodes succeeded.

tools.name: nodes.evaluate
tools.label: Inspect evaluated procedural geometry
tools.description: Evaluate graph and page derived vertices/faces with provenance and per-node cache/timing stats. Derived IDs cannot be used for direct mesh editing.

tools.name: mesh.provenance
tools.label: Resolve cumulative topology reference
tools.description: Resolve a vertex/edge/face ID from a recorded topology revision through all later splits/merges/deletions. Reports ambiguity or loss; legacy history before first recorded edit is unavailable.

tools.name: mesh.insetRegion
tools.label: Inset connected planar region
tools.description: Connected coplanar faces whose union has one strictly convex simple boundary, no holes. Atomic dissolve plus inset, cumulative lineage retained.

tools.name: mesh.bevelEdges
tools.label: Bevel several independent edges
tools.description: Up to16 convex edges with disjoint endpoints; existing trivalent planar bevel conditions apply to every step. Any failure rolls back all steps.

tools.name: mesh.createPolygon
tools.label: Create Polygon control mesh
tools.description: Create a quad cube or planar regular N-gon, with authoritative Polygon v2 topology. Writes file v56; reviewed Apply required.

tools.name: mesh.upgrade
tools.label: Upgrade triangle mesh to Polygon
tools.description: Explicit reversible upgrade of selected v55 triangle mesh to v56 Polygon. Preserves IDs and connectivity; does not dissolve triangles.

tools.name: mesh.extrudeRegion
tools.label: Extrude Polygon face region
tools.description: One connected coplanar consistently oriented face region. Signed normal distance in local mm. Shared vertices, boundary walls only. Polygon v2 required; reviewed validated transaction.

tools.name: mesh.inset
tools.label: Inset individual Polygon faces
tools.description: Individual strictly convex planar faces; positive inward edge offset in mm. Collapsing or invalid topology rejected atomically.

tools.name: mesh.bevel
tools.label: Bevel one convex edge
tools.description: One internal convex edge with closed trivalent endpoints. Distance ALONG neighboring edges, below half every incident length. One planar bevel strip; general multi-edge/segment bevel unsupported.

tools.name: mesh.bridge
tools.label: Bridge two boundary loops
tools.description: Two complete disjoint boundary loops. Optional resample=true splits boundary edges to LCM vertex count <=64, otherwise equal counts required. Explicit integer offset pairs reversed loops; no automatic correspondence or self-intersection detection.

tools.name: mesh.loopCut
tools.label: Cut a quad edge ring
tools.description: Continuous all-quad edge ring. Factor 0.001<factor<0.999 from lexically smaller source endpoint ID. Rejects rings touching non-quads.

tools.name: mesh.merge
tools.label: Merge adjacent vertices
tools.description: Exactly two adjacent vertices at midpoint, first ID survives; reports deleted/split references. Invalid topology rejects atomically.

tools.name: mesh.dissolve
tools.label: Dissolve an internal edge
tools.description: Two coplanar faces become one simple N-gon without holes. Deleted edge reference explicitly maps to no output.

tools.name: mesh.delete
tools.label: Delete mesh elements
tools.description: Remove selected faces or all faces incident to selected vertices/edges; remove unused vertices. Reject entire surface removal and non-manifold output.

tools.name: mesh.modifiers
tools.label: Review ordered modifier stack
tools.description: Replace complete ordered Catmull-Clark stack (max4, integer levels0–3). Smooth/fixed boundary, infinitely sharp control-edge creases. Bounded evaluation before Apply; source topology preserved. No semi-sharp crease/limit-surface evaluation.

tools.name: mesh.evaluation
tools.label: Inspect evaluated mesh and provenance
tools.description: Page evaluated vertices/faces/edges and mappings to control faces, control edges or weighted original vertices. Derived IDs are not editable references. Use small pages if provenance exceeds response budget.

tools.name: mesh.inspect
tools.label: Inspect editable mesh topology
tools.description: Read a page of authoritative local-mm vertices, polygon faces or stable edge references, persisted edit selection and structural validation scope. Not BRep tessellation. Reading grants no edit permission.

tools.name: mesh.create
tools.label: Create editable mesh cube
tools.description: Create a triangle mesh cube independent of BRep. Requires reviewed Apply; size is in mm.

tools.name: mesh.transform
tools.label: Transform mesh elements
tools.description: Move in object-local mm or scale about a supplied local pivot. Requires selected visible unlocked editable mesh and exact element IDs from mesh.inspect. Positive scale only. Shared transaction validates finite nondegenerate manifold topology, not self intersections.

tools.name: mesh.extrude
tools.label: Extrude one mesh triangle
tools.description: Extrude one explicitly identified triangle along its object-local normal by signed mm distance. Generates cap and six wall triangles with an explicit topology mapping. Requires selected editable mesh and reviewed Apply. No BRep conversion or self-intersection guarantee.

tools.name: scene.layer
tools.label: Create an organized CAD layer
tools.description: Create one uniquely named visible unlocked layer with explicit display color. Can accompany geometry and scene.objects in one reviewed transaction; does not change the user's active layer.

tools.name: scene.objects
tools.label: Move, name and finish objects
tools.description: Review explicit world XYZ delta translations in mm, names, output layer, visibility and optional 3D finish for up to 20 explicitly listed objects. Existing objects must be selected, independent, visible and unlocked; outputs created earlier in this proposal may be organized directly. Hidden source lines of native walls stay owned by their original layer. No geometry replacement, selection changes or unlocking.

tools.name: cad.pathClearance
tools.label: Check wall and doorway path clearance
tools.description: Bounded 2D circular-body path test against 1–64 explicitly listed upright unit-scale straight native walls. Full-height doors remove occupied wall intervals; windows do not count as walkable openings. Exact segment/rectangle distances. Does not check other solids, floors, door swing, room adjacency or evacuation/accessibility compliance.

tools.name: cad.architecture
tools.label: Inspect walls, openings and linked drawings
tools.description: Read wall/slab semantic sources, hosted door/window definitions, placement and linked section statuses for up to ten objects. Host along is measured from its source start; reading never grants edit selection.

tools.name: wall.create
tools.label: Create a native wall
tools.description: Create one XY straight centerline wall from explicit start/end XY coordinates, with positive height/thickness, world Z base level and optional hosted openings. Creates a hidden linked source line. Native wall commands own validation; optional explicit signed startMiter/endMiter degrees, no automatic junction graph.

tools.name: wall.opening
tools.label: Add or revise a hosted opening
tools.description: Upsert an exact door/window ID on one selected native wall. along is opening CENTER distance from source start, in mm; a door requires sill=0. refreshDrawings explicitly rebinds linked drawings in the same reviewed Undo. Overlap/outside/locked dependents reject atomically.

tools.name: wall.update
tools.label: Change native wall dimensions
tools.description: Change positive wall height/thickness and world Z base level on one selected native wall while retaining hosted openings and source ID. refreshDrawings explicitly rebinds linked drawings in this Undo. Optional start/end replace untransformed native centerline endpoints; explicit signed miter degrees retain the host and openings. Footprint thickness is source driven.

tools.name: slab.create
tools.label: Create a linked floor or ceiling
tools.description: Use selected closed XY drawing profiles (including supported holes) to create a native architectural floor/ceiling. Floor top is level and extends down by thickness; ceiling bottom is level and extends up. Existing analytical profile validation applies.

tools.name: drawing.section
tools.label: Derive a BRep plan or section
tools.description: Create an associated exact BRep cut from up to 64 selected existing solids, or prior walls/slabs in the same architectural proposal. XY height is world Z, XZ height world Y, YZ height world X. Registers stable parts; native output drawings are owned by this view. Set replaceExisting=true to explicitly replace the source membership of that exact existing section in one Review; otherwise IDs must be new. Does not invent a 2D section.

tools.name: drawing.refresh
tools.label: Explicitly rebind related drawings
tools.description: Rebuild captured sections/projections related to selected existing solids. Rebind is explicit and reviewed; ambiguous/missing/locked dependent output prevents atomic publication. This is not automatic topology guessing.

tools.name: cad.tools
tools.label: Discover CAD tools
tools.description: Return supported tool schemas, units and execution limits. Writes create a reviewable proposal; they never publish directly.

tools.name: cad.objects
tools.label: Find model objects
tools.description: Find up to 20 object IDs by name or ID. Reading a target does not select it for editing.

tools.name: cad.inspect
tools.label: Inspect objects and relationships
tools.description: Read types, source IDs, sketch ownership, numeric source parameters and editability for up to 10 objects.

tools.name: cad.measure
tools.label: Measure exact geometry
tools.description: Measure original geometry, with basis, validity, bbox, volume or area. Units mm, mm² and mm³.

tools.name: cad.faces
tools.label: Inspect solid faces
tools.description: Return up to 64 face keys, world tessellation meshBounds (selection aid, not exact containment) and resolved planar world frames. Hole centers are in the chosen face's local x/y axes, in mm. Face keys belong to the captured revision.

tools.name: cad.parameters
tools.label: Inspect editable solid dimensions
tools.description: Return the selected solid's supported length dimensions and drivers. Use the exact returned key with solid.parameter.

tools.name: cad.curve
tools.label: Inspect fitted curve points
tools.description: Read up to 60 editable fit points in source coordinates, its world transform, plane, explicit C1/C2 fit mode and analytic derivative / curvature-vector join gaps in source XYZ. Stationary joins have undefined curvature and are counted separately. Reading does not grant edit selection. Non-fitted or owned curves report a limitation.

tools.name: cad.edges
tools.label: Inspect solid edges
tools.description: Return up to 64 stable edge keys and representative world XYZ points in mm. Samples describe geometry, not exact lengths. Keys belong to this captured revision; use them for fillet or chamfer.

tools.name: draft.text
tools.label: Create a CAD annotation
tools.description: Create literal bounded plain text in source world XYZ on an origin work plane. No HTML or script execution. Height in mm. This is static annotation, not generated knowledge or a room label linked to area.

tools.name: draft.linearDimension
tools.label: Create a static linear dimension
tools.description: Create a measured static annotation from two explicit plane XY points in mm. It is not linked to geometry; subsequent source changes require review. No arbitrary measurement text override.

tools.name: curve.circle
tools.label: Create a planar circle
tools.description: Create an editable circle with world XYZ center, origin-plane orientation and radius in mm. Center elevation allows loft sections at different heights.

tools.name: curve.fitted
tools.label: Create a fitted spline
tools.description: Create an exact editable spline through 3–60 world XYZ points with planar coordinates by default; optional space:spatial permits true XYZ. Plane remains the reference editing view. Omit repeated closing point. Optional continuity defaults to C1 cardinal interpolation with tangent strength. C2 uses natural open / periodic closed cubic interpolation with strength exactly 1. Original points and exact basis are retained. Units mm.

tools.name: curve.reshape
tools.label: Reshape a selected fitted spline
tools.description: Standalone edit of one selected independent fitted spline. Use cad.curve source-coordinate points, retain its reference plane, open/closed status and object transform. Optional space retains the current mode; switching a nonplanar path to planar is refused. Hidden/locked/owned curves cannot be edited. Optional continuity retains the current mode when omitted; C2 requires strength 1. Live solids regenerate; snapshot derivatives are not automatically rebuilt.

tools.name: curve.adjust
tools.label: Adjust one fitted point
tools.description: Standalone exact change to one selected independent fitted spline fit point. Zero-based pointIndex and source-coordinate delta XYZ in mm. Retains every other fit point, continuity mode, tension, plane, closure and placement. Prefer this to resending all points for a precise local edit. Read cad.curve first if the index is unknown.

tools.name: curve.polyline
tools.label: Create a planar profile or path
tools.description: Create 2–64 world XYZ vertices on one plane parallel to the given origin plane. Closed profiles require at least 3 vertices; omit a repeated closing vertex. Open paths can feed sweep. Units mm.

tools.name: solid.revolve
tools.label: Revolve a closed profile
tools.description: Revolve one closed profile without holes around its work-plane x or y axis through world origin. Angle is explicit degrees, up to 360. Axis names are plane-local, not world axes.

tools.name: solid.sweep
tools.label: Sweep along a path
tools.description: Sweep one closed profile without holes along an open drawing path. Spline paths retain their exact world-space NURBS basis; no display samples enter the sweep. Optional alignToPath rotates the section perpendicular to the initial tangent before corrected-Frenet transport; the section should be centered at the path start. Default false retains existing orientation. It is not a roll-angle control. Arc paths use the existing sampled polyline approximation. All source IDs must be selected or earlier proposal results.

tools.name: solid.loft
tools.label: Loft ordered sections
tools.description: Join 2–10 closed profiles without holes, in explicit section order. ruled chooses straight generators; false uses smooth interpolation. Sources stay linked.

tools.name: solid.loft.update
tools.label: Change loft connection
tools.description: Standalone edit of exactly one selected visible unlocked live loft. Toggle ruled straight section spans or smooth interpolation while retaining object ID, source section order, placement and finish. Not arbitrary face deformation or conversion of boxes/meshes. Two sections can give equivalent geometry; smooth is not a guaranteed curvature-continuity class. Native validation and downstream reference checks precede Apply.

tools.name: solid.fillet
tools.label: Round selected edges
tools.description: Round exact cad.edges keys on one selected existing solid. Apply new solids before querying edges. Radius in mm.

tools.name: solid.chamfer
tools.label: Chamfer selected edges
tools.description: Apply a symmetric chamfer to exact cad.edges keys on one selected existing solid. Distance in mm; apply new solids before querying edges.

tools.name: solid.shell
tools.label: Hollow a solid
tools.description: Remove exact cad.faces keys from one selected existing solid and offset inward by positive thickness in mm. Apply new solids before querying faces. Invalid offsets reject the proposal.

tools.name: sketch.create
tools.label: Create a sketch
tools.description: Create a sketch on an origin plane. Include its geometry in the same proposal. New IDs must be unique.

tools.name: sketch.rectangle
tools.label: Add a constrained rectangle
tools.description: Add an anchored, dimensioned rectangle in sketch coordinates. Use a new sketch or the owner sketch of a selected profile.

tools.name: sketch.circle
tools.label: Add a constrained circle
tools.description: Add a fixed-center, dimensioned circle in sketch coordinates. Inner circles inside an outer loop become holes when extruded.

tools.name: solid.primitive
tools.label: Create a primitive solid
tools.description: Create box(width,depth,height), cylinder(radius,height), sphere(radius), cone(radius1,radius2,height), or torus(majorRadius,minorRadius). Position is world XYZ in mm; provide exactly the parameters for that primitive.

tools.name: solid.parameter
tools.label: Change a selected solid dimension
tools.description: Change one advertised selected-solid length dimension. Use cad.parameters for its exact key. This edit must be a standalone modeling proposal.

tools.name: solid.extrude
tools.label: Extrude closed profiles
tools.description: Extrude selected or newly created profiles along their plane's positive normal, in mm. Source relationships remain editable. Closed planar spline, line/arc and circle boundaries classify exact holes and islands by containment, independent of selection order. Each spline must be a complete closed boundary; chained mixed spline edges are unsupported.

tools.name: solid.boolean
tools.label: Combine solids
tools.description: Union, cut (target minus tool), or intersect two selected/new solids. Inputs are hidden and the linked result is selected.

tools.name: solid.hole
tools.label: Create a face-bound hole
tools.description: Cut a circular hole on a selected existing solid using an exact face key from cad.faces. Center uses that face's local frame, not world XY. Through holes omit depth; blind holes require positive depth. Apply a newly created solid before querying its faces.

summary: 기존 회전 기능을 유지하면서 지지대와 받침판 사이의 관통 문제를 해결하고자 함.
다른 부품은 변경 없이 최대한 그대로 두고자 하며, 제조 공차·하중·재료·체결 방식은 미확정임.

request.prompt:
회전 기능은 유지하면서 지지대와 받침판 사이의 관통을 줄여줘. 다른 부품은 최대한 그대로 두고 싶어.
기존 Revolute Joint와 회전축 위치 유지. 지지대–받침판 관통 감소. 다른 부품의 불필요한 변경 최소화. 제조 공차·하중·재료·체결 방식은 미확정이며 임의로 확정하지 않는다. 모든 수정안은 사용자 검토 대상이며 Apply하지 않는다.

recipes.label: 4홀 플레이트
recipes.description: Rectangular plate with exactly four circular through holes; margin is hole-center distance from adjacent edges.
recipes.placement: World XY at origin, extrusion along +Z. Independent new object; never attaches to a selected face.

recipes.label: 원통 핀
recipes.description: Plain solid cylindrical pin without head, threads, taper or chamfer; base center at origin, axis +Z.
recipes.placement: World XY at origin, extrusion along +Z. Independent new object; never attaches to a selected face.

recipes.label: 통풍 덮개
recipes.description: Flat rectangular lid with an evenly spaced rectangular grid of circular through vents, at most 64 holes. No rim, lip, slots or fasteners. Margin is outermost hole-center distance from each edge; a single row/column is centered.
recipes.placement: World XY at origin, extrusion along +Z. Independent new object; never attaches to a selected face.

tools.name: assembly.joint.delete
tools.label: Review Joint deletion
tools.description: Delete only the Joint. Child becomes a free ungrounded root at current world pose; downstream Joints retained. Select child. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.reparent
tools.label: Review Joint reparent
tools.description: Select child and new parent. preserveWorld true recaptures rest at current angle; false reuses local bind and moves subtree. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.edit
tools.label: Review Joint frame/limits
tools.description: Select child. editJson has origin/axis/min/max; null limits clear. No angle or type changes. preserveWorld explicit. Current angle outside new limits is rejected, never clamped.

tools.name: assembly.motion.inspect
tools.label: Inspect discrete Joint motion
tools.description: Read-only bounded BRep interference sweep. optionsJson: jointId,start,end,positive step,partIds 2..8,exceptions explicit ID pairs,tolerance 1e-7..0.01mm. start=end checks one pose (no duplicate interference API). Max13 samples. Reports raw and exception-filtered results; unknown is never clear. Native document unchanged.

tools.name: assembly.inspect
tools.label: Inspect assembly
tools.description: Read grounded objects, Joint graph, bind frames and paginated design-intent annotations. Annotations never change geometry. Motion rows expose structurally proven relativeMotion.

tools.name: assembly.joint.validate
tools.label: Validate assembly joints
tools.description: Validate stored Joint references/limits/cycles. No changes.

tools.name: assembly.joint.create
tools.label: Review Joint creation
tools.description: jointJson: id,type fixed/revolute,parentId,childId,origin parent-local mm,unit axis,angle degrees,min/max optional. Zero angle is current bind pose. Select both parts. Native Review only.

tools.name: assembly.joint.update
tools.label: Review absolute Joint angle
tools.description: Select child; absolute degrees from bind pose. Review only.

tools.name: assembly.ground
tools.label: Review grounded part
tools.description: Select independent root. Grounded transforms cannot be moved.

tools.name: reconstruction.analyze
tools.label: Analyze planar Mesh regions
tools.description: Analyze components, boundaries, plane/hole candidates and adjacency. Optional absoluteTolerance mm (default 1e-5), relativeTolerance (1e-8), angleDegrees (1). Not solid certification.

tools.name: reconstruction.preview
tools.label: Evaluate planar BRep quality
tools.description: Read-only bounded OpenCascade reconstruction and bidirectional sampled error report. Open/multiple components refused. No direct publication.

tools.name: reconstruction.create
tools.label: Review planar BRep reconstruction
tools.description: Preserve selected Mesh and propose an independent merged-planar BRep after kernel validity/error validation. Native Preview/Apply only; no raw BRep injection.

tools.name: reconstruction.result
tools.label: Inspect reconstructed BRep
tools.description: Read reconstruction quality/face correspondence and source snapshot match. No automatic regeneration.

tools.name: hybrid.inspect
tools.label: Inspect Hybrid geometry
tools.description: Read source references, conversion receipt and support policy.

tools.name: hybrid.reference.validate
tools.label: Resolve Mesh surface reference
tools.description: Resolve exact triangle material point. Reports invalid/unresolved without nearest-face substitution.

tools.name: hybrid.reference.create
tools.label: Review Mesh surface reference
tools.description: Capture or explicitly reselect a named reference using object-local ray JSON {origin:[x,y,z],direction:[x,y,z]}. Procedural outputs require Bake. Native Review/Apply.

tools.name: hybrid.datum.create
tools.label: Review datum and precise prism
tools.description: Enable Mesh datum and create an exact rectangular OpenCascade extrusion with dimensions in mm. Source-preserving live dependency; native Review/Apply.

tools.name: hybrid.brep.toMesh
tools.label: Review planar BRep conversion
tools.description: Independent editable mesh from a BRep box or Hybrid rectangular prism. Preserves source; validates welding, closed manifold and intersections. Curved/general solids unsupported.

tools.name: sculpt.inspect
tools.label: Inspect sculpt target
tools.description: Read editable mesh brush capabilities, object-local coordinate rules, limits and detached bake status.

tools.name: sculpt.stroke
tools.label: Review sculpt stroke
tools.description: Validated frozen-source stroke JSON: brush grab/draw/smooth/inflate/crease/flatten, radius mm, strength [-1,1] nonzero, falloff linear/smooth/sharp, spacing [.02,1], symmetry boolean, samples 1..128 {origin:[x,y,z],direction:[x,y,z],delta?:[x,y,z]}. Rays hit actual source surface; grab uses first ray and last delta (max twice radius). Native Preview/Apply; never accepts raw vertices.

tools.name: sculpt.preview
tools.label: Evaluate sculpt preview
tools.description: Evaluate the same bounded stroke engine without modifying document. Returns a 120-second source-bound previewId. Same strokeJson contract as sculpt.stroke.

tools.name: sculpt.apply
tools.label: Review validated sculpt preview
tools.description: Prepare native Review from a valid sculpt.preview receipt. Reject stale/expired source. Existing native Apply policy remains: user confirms in editor; this tool cannot publish directly.

tools.name: mesh.bake
tools.label: Bake evaluated mesh for sculpt
tools.description: Create independent editable Polygon mesh from Mesh modifiers or Geometry Nodes. Retain original source, record snapshot fingerprint. No automatic rebasing after source edits.

tools.name: mesh.remesh
tools.label: Review surface or voxel remesh
tools.description: New object, original preserved. optionsJson is {method:surface,iterations:1..3,relaxation:0..0.5} or {method:voxel,resolution:4..24}. Surface uses uniform triangle refinement/projected relaxation; voxel uses closed manifold occupancy boundary (stair steps). Reject invalid/intersecting outputs. Explicit old-reference loss and sampled distance report.

tools.name: mesh.remesh.inspect
tools.label: Inspect remesh losses and deviation
tools.description: Read stored conversion report, source fingerprint, sampled distances and explicit lost topology counts. Not a certified geometric error bound.

tools.name: nodes.catalog
tools.label: Read node type and parameter catalog
tools.description: All supported Geometry Nodes types, typed sockets and exact default parameter objects. Unknown fields/types are rejected. Curve primitive supports circle {kind,radius,segments} or polyline {kind,points,closed}.

tools.name: nodes.create
tools.label: Create procedural geometry graph
tools.description: Create a working typed Geometry Nodes graph. Presets: mesh subdivision, open curve profile sweep, realized instances, or live selected mesh input. Reviewed validated Apply; file v57. No BRep conversion.

tools.name: nodes.inspect
tools.label: Read Geometry Nodes graph
tools.description: Read paginated node IDs, exact parameter values, typed links, live external inputs, active output and draft diagnostics. Read grants no edit permission.

tools.name: nodes.add
tools.label: Add typed geometry node
tools.description: Add a unique node with exact JSON parameter object. Disconnected nodes remain explicit inactive drafts, not successful evaluated outputs. Types and parameters are strictly validated.

tools.name: nodes.remove
tools.label: Remove a geometry node
tools.description: Delete an existing node and incident links. Group Output cannot be deleted. Required active inputs cannot be left disconnected; use nodes.edit for atomic rewiring.

tools.name: nodes.connect
tools.label: Connect typed geometry nodes
tools.description: Connect source single output to named destination input. Reject type mismatches/cycles. replace=true atomically replaces existing socket connection.

tools.name: nodes.disconnect
tools.label: Disconnect geometry node input
tools.description: Remove exact existing input link. Reject if active output becomes incomplete; use nodes.edit to rewire atomically.

tools.name: nodes.parameters
tools.label: Change geometry node parameters
tools.description: Replace one node's complete parameter object as JSON, using exact schema. Evaluation and downstream invalidation precede reviewed Apply.

tools.name: nodes.edit
tools.label: Atomic graph actions
tools.description: JSON array (1–128) of typed actions: add {node:{id,type,params}}, remove {nodeId}, parameters {nodeId,params}, connect {link:{from,to,input}}, disconnect {nodeId,input}; every action has kind. Only this graph can be changed. Final graph must be acyclic, typed, complete on active output and evaluable within budget.

tools.name: nodes.validate
tools.label: Validate and evaluate node graph
tools.description: Return structural diagnostics and actual bounded evaluation success/failure; never mutate source or pretend unsupported nodes succeeded.

tools.name: nodes.evaluate
tools.label: Inspect evaluated procedural geometry
tools.description: Evaluate graph and page derived vertices/faces with provenance and per-node cache/timing stats. Derived IDs cannot be used for direct mesh editing.

tools.name: mesh.provenance
tools.label: Resolve cumulative topology reference
tools.description: Resolve a vertex/edge/face ID from a recorded topology revision through all later splits/merges/deletions. Reports ambiguity or loss; legacy history before first recorded edit is unavailable.

tools.name: mesh.insetRegion
tools.label: Inset connected planar region
tools.description: Connected coplanar faces whose union has one strictly convex simple boundary, no holes. Atomic dissolve plus inset, cumulative lineage retained.

tools.name: mesh.bevelEdges
tools.label: Bevel several independent edges
tools.description: Up to16 convex edges with disjoint endpoints; existing trivalent planar bevel conditions apply to every step. Any failure rolls back all steps.

tools.name: mesh.createPolygon
tools.label: Create Polygon control mesh
tools.description: Create a quad cube or planar regular N-gon, with authoritative Polygon v2 topology. Writes file v56; reviewed Apply required.

tools.name: mesh.upgrade
tools.label: Upgrade triangle mesh to Polygon
tools.description: Explicit reversible upgrade of selected v55 triangle mesh to v56 Polygon. Preserves IDs and connectivity; does not dissolve triangles.

tools.name: mesh.extrudeRegion
tools.label: Extrude Polygon face region
tools.description: One connected coplanar consistently oriented face region. Signed normal distance in local mm. Shared vertices, boundary walls only. Polygon v2 required; reviewed validated transaction.

tools.name: mesh.inset
tools.label: Inset individual Polygon faces
tools.description: Individual strictly convex planar faces; positive inward edge offset in mm. Collapsing or invalid topology rejected atomically.

tools.name: mesh.bevel
tools.label: Bevel one convex edge
tools.description: One internal convex edge with closed trivalent endpoints. Distance ALONG neighboring edges, below half every incident length. One planar bevel strip; general multi-edge/segment bevel unsupported.

tools.name: mesh.bridge
tools.label: Bridge two boundary loops
tools.description: Two complete disjoint boundary loops. Optional resample=true splits boundary edges to LCM vertex count <=64, otherwise equal counts required. Explicit integer offset pairs reversed loops; no automatic correspondence or self-intersection detection.

tools.name: mesh.loopCut
tools.label: Cut a quad edge ring
tools.description: Continuous all-quad edge ring. Factor 0.001<factor<0.999 from lexically smaller source endpoint ID. Rejects rings touching non-quads.

tools.name: mesh.merge
tools.label: Merge adjacent vertices
tools.description: Exactly two adjacent vertices at midpoint, first ID survives; reports deleted/split references. Invalid topology rejects atomically.

tools.name: mesh.dissolve
tools.label: Dissolve an internal edge
tools.description: Two coplanar faces become one simple N-gon without holes. Deleted edge reference explicitly maps to no output.

tools.name: mesh.delete
tools.label: Delete mesh elements
tools.description: Remove selected faces or all faces incident to selected vertices/edges; remove unused vertices. Reject entire surface removal and non-manifold output.

tools.name: mesh.modifiers
tools.label: Review ordered modifier stack
tools.description: Replace complete ordered Catmull-Clark stack (max4, integer levels0–3). Smooth/fixed boundary, infinitely sharp control-edge creases. Bounded evaluation before Apply; source topology preserved. No semi-sharp crease/limit-surface evaluation.

tools.name: mesh.evaluation
tools.label: Inspect evaluated mesh and provenance
tools.description: Page evaluated vertices/faces/edges and mappings to control faces, control edges or weighted original vertices. Derived IDs are not editable references. Use small pages if provenance exceeds response budget.

tools.name: mesh.inspect
tools.label: Inspect editable mesh topology
tools.description: Read a page of authoritative local-mm vertices, polygon faces or stable edge references, persisted edit selection and structural validation scope. Not BRep tessellation. Reading grants no edit permission.

tools.name: mesh.create
tools.label: Create editable mesh cube
tools.description: Create a triangle mesh cube independent of BRep. Requires reviewed Apply; size is in mm.

tools.name: mesh.transform
tools.label: Transform mesh elements
tools.description: Move in object-local mm or scale about a supplied local pivot. Requires selected visible unlocked editable mesh and exact element IDs from mesh.inspect. Positive scale only. Shared transaction validates finite nondegenerate manifold topology, not self intersections.

tools.name: mesh.extrude
tools.label: Extrude one mesh triangle
tools.description: Extrude one explicitly identified triangle along its object-local normal by signed mm distance. Generates cap and six wall triangles with an explicit topology mapping. Requires selected editable mesh and reviewed Apply. No BRep conversion or self-intersection guarantee.

tools.name: scene.layer
tools.label: Create an organized CAD layer
tools.description: Create one uniquely named visible unlocked layer with explicit display color. Can accompany geometry and scene.objects in one reviewed transaction; does not change the user's active layer.

tools.name: scene.objects
tools.label: Move, name and finish objects
tools.description: Review explicit world XYZ delta translations in mm, names, output layer, visibility and optional 3D finish for up to 20 explicitly listed objects. Existing objects must be selected, independent, visible and unlocked; outputs created earlier in this proposal may be organized directly. Hidden source lines of native walls stay owned by their original layer. No geometry replacement, selection changes or unlocking.

tools.name: cad.pathClearance
tools.label: Check wall and doorway path clearance
tools.description: Bounded 2D circular-body path test against 1–64 explicitly listed upright unit-scale straight native walls. Full-height doors remove occupied wall intervals; windows do not count as walkable openings. Exact segment/rectangle distances. Does not check other solids, floors, door swing, room adjacency or evacuation/accessibility compliance.

tools.name: cad.architecture
tools.label: Inspect walls, openings and linked drawings
tools.description: Read wall/slab semantic sources, hosted door/window definitions, placement and linked section statuses for up to ten objects. Host along is measured from its source start; reading never grants edit selection.

tools.name: wall.create
tools.label: Create a native wall
tools.description: Create one XY straight centerline wall from explicit start/end XY coordinates, with positive height/thickness, world Z base level and optional hosted openings. Creates a hidden linked source line. Native wall commands own validation; optional explicit signed startMiter/endMiter degrees, no automatic junction graph.

tools.name: wall.opening
tools.label: Add or revise a hosted opening
tools.description: Upsert an exact door/window ID on one selected native wall. along is opening CENTER distance from source start, in mm; a door requires sill=0. refreshDrawings explicitly rebinds linked drawings in the same reviewed Undo. Overlap/outside/locked dependents reject atomically.

tools.name: wall.update
tools.label: Change native wall dimensions
tools.description: Change positive wall height/thickness and world Z base level on one selected native wall while retaining hosted openings and source ID. refreshDrawings explicitly rebinds linked drawings in this Undo. Optional start/end replace untransformed native centerline endpoints; explicit signed miter degrees retain the host and openings. Footprint thickness is source driven.

tools.name: slab.create
tools.label: Create a linked floor or ceiling
tools.description: Use selected closed XY drawing profiles (including supported holes) to create a native architectural floor/ceiling. Floor top is level and extends down by thickness; ceiling bottom is level and extends up. Existing analytical profile validation applies.

tools.name: drawing.section
tools.label: Derive a BRep plan or section
tools.description: Create an associated exact BRep cut from up to 64 selected existing solids, or prior walls/slabs in the same architectural proposal. XY height is world Z, XZ height world Y, YZ height world X. Registers stable parts; native output drawings are owned by this view. Set replaceExisting=true to explicitly replace the source membership of that exact existing section in one Review; otherwise IDs must be new. Does not invent a 2D section.

tools.name: drawing.refresh
tools.label: Explicitly rebind related drawings
tools.description: Rebuild captured sections/projections related to selected existing solids. Rebind is explicit and reviewed; ambiguous/missing/locked dependent output prevents atomic publication. This is not automatic topology guessing.

tools.name: cad.tools
tools.label: Discover CAD tools
tools.description: Return supported tool schemas, units and execution limits. Writes create a reviewable proposal; they never publish directly.

tools.name: cad.objects
tools.label: Find model objects
tools.description: Find up to 20 object IDs by name or ID. Reading a target does not select it for editing.

tools.name: cad.inspect
tools.label: Inspect objects and relationships
tools.description: Read types, source IDs, sketch ownership, numeric source parameters and editability for up to 10 objects.

tools.name: cad.measure
tools.label: Measure exact geometry
tools.description: Measure original geometry, with basis, validity, bbox, volume or area. Units mm, mm² and mm³.

tools.name: cad.faces
tools.label: Inspect solid faces
tools.description: Return up to 64 face keys, world tessellation meshBounds (selection aid, not exact containment) and resolved planar world frames. Hole centers are in the chosen face's local x/y axes, in mm. Face keys belong to the captured revision.

tools.name: cad.parameters
tools.label: Inspect editable solid dimensions
tools.description: Return the selected solid's supported length dimensions and drivers. Use the exact returned key with solid.parameter.

tools.name: cad.curve
tools.label: Inspect fitted curve points
tools.description: Read up to 60 editable fit points in source coordinates, its world transform, plane, explicit C1/C2 fit mode and analytic derivative / curvature-vector join gaps in source XYZ. Stationary joins have undefined curvature and are counted separately. Reading does not grant edit selection. Non-fitted or owned curves report a limitation.

tools.name: cad.edges
tools.label: Inspect solid edges
tools.description: Return up to 64 stable edge keys and representative world XYZ points in mm. Samples describe geometry, not exact lengths. Keys belong to this captured revision; use them for fillet or chamfer.

tools.name: draft.text
tools.label: Create a CAD annotation
tools.description: Create literal bounded plain text in source world XYZ on an origin work plane. No HTML or script execution. Height in mm. This is static annotation, not generated knowledge or a room label linked to area.

tools.name: draft.linearDimension
tools.label: Create a static linear dimension
tools.description: Create a measured static annotation from two explicit plane XY points in mm. It is not linked to geometry; subsequent source changes require review. No arbitrary measurement text override.

tools.name: curve.circle
tools.label: Create a planar circle
tools.description: Create an editable circle with world XYZ center, origin-plane orientation and radius in mm. Center elevation allows loft sections at different heights.

tools.name: curve.fitted
tools.label: Create a fitted spline
tools.description: Create an exact editable spline through 3–60 world XYZ points with planar coordinates by default; optional space:spatial permits true XYZ. Plane remains the reference editing view. Omit repeated closing point. Optional continuity defaults to C1 cardinal interpolation with tangent strength. C2 uses natural open / periodic closed cubic interpolation with strength exactly 1. Original points and exact basis are retained. Units mm.

tools.name: curve.reshape
tools.label: Reshape a selected fitted spline
tools.description: Standalone edit of one selected independent fitted spline. Use cad.curve source-coordinate points, retain its reference plane, open/closed status and object transform. Optional space retains the current mode; switching a nonplanar path to planar is refused. Hidden/locked/owned curves cannot be edited. Optional continuity retains the current mode when omitted; C2 requires strength 1. Live solids regenerate; snapshot derivatives are not automatically rebuilt.

tools.name: curve.adjust
tools.label: Adjust one fitted point
tools.description: Standalone exact change to one selected independent fitted spline fit point. Zero-based pointIndex and source-coordinate delta XYZ in mm. Retains every other fit point, continuity mode, tension, plane, closure and placement. Prefer this to resending all points for a precise local edit. Read cad.curve first if the index is unknown.

tools.name: curve.polyline
tools.label: Create a planar profile or path
tools.description: Create 2–64 world XYZ vertices on one plane parallel to the given origin plane. Closed profiles require at least 3 vertices; omit a repeated closing vertex. Open paths can feed sweep. Units mm.

tools.name: solid.revolve
tools.label: Revolve a closed profile
tools.description: Revolve one closed profile without holes around its work-plane x or y axis through world origin. Angle is explicit degrees, up to 360. Axis names are plane-local, not world axes.

tools.name: solid.sweep
tools.label: Sweep along a path
tools.description: Sweep one closed profile without holes along an open drawing path. Spline paths retain their exact world-space NURBS basis; no display samples enter the sweep. Optional alignToPath rotates the section perpendicular to the initial tangent before corrected-Frenet transport; the section should be centered at the path start. Default false retains existing orientation. It is not a roll-angle control. Arc paths use the existing sampled polyline approximation. All source IDs must be selected or earlier proposal results.

tools.name: solid.loft
tools.label: Loft ordered sections
tools.description: Join 2–10 closed profiles without holes, in explicit section order. ruled chooses straight generators; false uses smooth interpolation. Sources stay linked.

tools.name: solid.loft.update
tools.label: Change loft connection
tools.description: Standalone edit of exactly one selected visible unlocked live loft. Toggle ruled straight section spans or smooth interpolation while retaining object ID, source section order, placement and finish. Not arbitrary face deformation or conversion of boxes/meshes. Two sections can give equivalent geometry; smooth is not a guaranteed curvature-continuity class. Native validation and downstream reference checks precede Apply.

tools.name: solid.fillet
tools.label: Round selected edges
tools.description: Round exact cad.edges keys on one selected existing solid. Apply new solids before querying edges. Radius in mm.

tools.name: solid.chamfer
tools.label: Chamfer selected edges
tools.description: Apply a symmetric chamfer to exact cad.edges keys on one selected existing solid. Distance in mm; apply new solids before querying edges.

tools.name: solid.shell
tools.label: Hollow a solid
tools.description: Remove exact cad.faces keys from one selected existing solid and offset inward by positive thickness in mm. Apply new solids before querying faces. Invalid offsets reject the proposal.

tools.name: sketch.create
tools.label: Create a sketch
tools.description: Create a sketch on an origin plane. Include its geometry in the same proposal. New IDs must be unique.

tools.name: sketch.rectangle
tools.label: Add a constrained rectangle
tools.description: Add an anchored, dimensioned rectangle in sketch coordinates. Use a new sketch or the owner sketch of a selected profile.

tools.name: sketch.circle
tools.label: Add a constrained circle
tools.description: Add a fixed-center, dimensioned circle in sketch coordinates. Inner circles inside an outer loop become holes when extruded.

tools.name: solid.primitive
tools.label: Create a primitive solid
tools.description: Create box(width,depth,height), cylinder(radius,height), sphere(radius), cone(radius1,radius2,height), or torus(majorRadius,minorRadius). Position is world XYZ in mm; provide exactly the parameters for that primitive.

tools.name: solid.parameter
tools.label: Change a selected solid dimension
tools.description: Change one advertised selected-solid length dimension. Use cad.parameters for its exact key. This edit must be a standalone modeling proposal.

tools.name: solid.extrude
tools.label: Extrude closed profiles
tools.description: Extrude selected or newly created profiles along their plane's positive normal, in mm. Source relationships remain editable. Closed planar spline, line/arc and circle boundaries classify exact holes and islands by containment, independent of selection order. Each spline must be a complete closed boundary; chained mixed spline edges are unsupported.

tools.name: solid.boolean
tools.label: Combine solids
tools.description: Union, cut (target minus tool), or intersect two selected/new solids. Inputs are hidden and the linked result is selected.

tools.name: solid.hole
tools.label: Create a face-bound hole
tools.description: Cut a circular hole on a selected existing solid using an exact face key from cad.faces. Center uses that face's local frame, not world XY. Through holes omit depth; blind holes require positive depth. Apply a newly created solid before querying its faces.
